news.title: Final dividend of ₹75.00 announced
news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹75.00. Ex-date: 24th July 2026 Payment date: 4th September 2026 Dividend yield will be 3.5%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.9%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by both earnings (64% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (51% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 12% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 23% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹287 (vs ₹219 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹287 (up from ₹219 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹474.1b (up 16% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹57.4b (up 31% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 12% (up from 11% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 6.9% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 8.7% growth forecast for the Auto industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 23% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 26% per year.

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹110
news.body: Dividend of ₹110 is 10% higher than last year. Ex-date: 11th February 2026 Payment date: 7th March 2026 Dividend yield will be 3.0%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.9%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by both earnings (64% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (79% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 11% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 25% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹63.36 (vs ₹55.38 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹63.36 (up from ₹55.38 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹127.8b (up 25% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹12.7b (up 14% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 9.9% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 7.6% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 8.6% growth forecast for the Auto industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 24% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 31% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Hero MotoCorp Ltd Appoints Shivalika Chadha Malik as Head of Communications - External and Internal
news.body: Hero MotoCorp Ltd. has appointed Shivalika Chadha Malik as Head of Communications - External and Internal, overseeing both India and global markets. In her new role, Malik will lead the company's communications strategy at a time when the world's largest manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters continues to evolve its global presence and purpose-led initiatives. Prior to joining Hero MotoCorp, Malik spent six years at PepsiCo, where she last served as Associate Director - Brand Communications for the AMESA region (Africa, Middle East and South Asia). She began her journey at PepsiCo as Senior Manager - Communications for PepsiCo India and went on to take on expanded regional responsibilities.
